violations.text: The hand sink in the back prep area was observed to be in poor repair (water off due to leak). A plumbing system shall be in good repair and proper adjustment. New Violation. Correct By: 08/18/2026

Milk was observed held at 48 degrees Fahrenheit in the reach in cooler. The ambient temperature of the unit was observed to be 47 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Per PIC, milk was left in the unit overnight. PIC voluntarily disposed of food at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2024

The reach in cooler was observed maintaining an ambient temperature of 47 degrees Fahrenheit. Unit to be taken out of service until it can be repaired/replaced/serviced. New Violation. Correct By: 06/03/2024
